ioreg_uuid_block.command:
python3 -I -c 
import re,subprocess,pathlib,json
mount='<PATH>'
m=subprocess.run(["/sbin/mount"],capture_output=True,text=True)
line=next(l for l in m.stdout.splitlines() if " on "+mount+" (" in l)
dev=line.split(" on ",1)[0]
r=subprocess.run(["/usr/sbin/ioreg","-r","-c","IOMedia","-l","-w","0"],capture_output=True,text=True)
lines=r.stdout.splitlines();uuid=None;name=None;blk=[]
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    if '"BSD Name" = "'+pathlib.Path(dev).name+'"' in l:
        blk=lines[max(0,i-55):i+1]
        for x in reversed(blk):
            q=re.search(r'"UUID" = "([^"]+)"',x)
            if q and uuid is None:uuid=q.group(1)
            q=re.search(r'"FullName" = "([^"]+)"',x)
            if q and name is None:name=q.group(1)
        break
print(json.dumps({"device":dev,"bsd_name":pathlib.Path(dev).name,"media_uuid":uuid,
 "volume_name":name,"block":blk[-14:]},indent=1))

clauses.statement: Stable identity is the IOMedia VolumeUUID 9584F366-F6FB-4A40-AA75-DB2EA0FA01EA, which survives unplug/remount. A BSD device name (disk5s1, disk7s1) and an st_dev value are reassigned on every mount and are never identity: config/storage.json now declares identity_authoritative_field=iomedia_uuid, resolves identity with the same VolumeUUID readback env.sh line 2 uses, and demotes the former observed_device/observed_st_dev pin (was lines 8-9) to device_observation_sample with authoritative=false, is_pin=false. No numeric disk identifier is required by any consumer: tools/control.py storage_check() reads iomedia_uuid and minimum_free_bytes only and records the live device as observed output, never compared to a stored pin.

evidence.survives_remount: VolumeUUID is bound to the filesystem itself, read identically by env.sh line 2 (diskutil info -plist | plutil -extract VolumeUUID raw) and tools/control.py's IOMedia readback. Observed across samples: disk5s1/16777240 at discovery and disk7s1/16777244 live with the SAME VolumeUUID - the device identity changed while the UUID identity did not. Re-pinning the live BSD name would re-fail on the next remount, so the pin is expressed as the UUID.
evidence.why_numeric_sample_remains: device_observation_sample is kept only as non-authoritative discovery provenance (authoritative=false, is_pin=false) and is read by nothing; identity_authoritative_field names iomedia_uuid as the single authoritative field.

clauses.gap: tools/control.py:282 is the only config read in storage_check(); it reads minimum_free_bytes, never observed_device or observed_st_dev. The live device number in the output is written, not compared.
clauses.reason: The transient pair was a stale, unenforced pin; keeping it as a pin would re-fail every remount. Identity is anchored to the VolumeUUID; numeric identifiers are demoted to a non-authoritative sample.

python3 -I -c 
import json,os,pathlib
paths=json.loads('["<PATH>/Downloads/git trees and automations", "<PATH>/Downloads/git trees and automations/worktrees", "<PATH>/Downloads/git trees and automations/scratch", "<PATH>/Downloads/git trees and automations/tmp/purple-billboard", "<PATH>/Downloads/git trees and automations/tmp/purple-billboard-caches", "<PATH>/Downloads/git trees and automations/Purple-Billboard-Client-System-Build", "<PATH>/Downloads/git trees and automations/worktrees/pb-skill38-20261024/b-t-04", "<PATH>/Downloads/git trees and automations/worktrees/pb-skill38-20261024/b-t-04/evidence", "<PATH>/Downloads/git trees and automations/scratch/pb-skill38-20261024/lanes/PBB-177-lane", "<PATH>/Downloads/git trees and automations/scratch/pb-skill38-20261024/lanes/PBB-177-lane/tmp-probe", "<PATH>/Downloads/git trees and automations/scratch/pb-skill38-20261024/lanes/PBB-177-lane/cache-probe"]')
mount=pathlib.Path("<PATH>")
md=mount.stat().st_dev
res=[]
for p in paths:
    q=pathlib.Path(p)
    rec={"path":p,"exists":q.exists(),"is_dir":q.is_dir() if q.exists() else None}
    if q.exists():
        rec["st_dev"]=q.stat().st_dev
        rec["same_device_as_mount"]=rec["st_dev"]==md
        rec["is_symlink"]=q.is_symlink()
        rec["resolved_equals_path"]=os.path.realpath(p)==os.path.abspath(p)
        cur=pathlib.Path("/");sym=[];rebase=False
        for part in q.absolute().parts[1:]:
            cur=cur/part
            if cur.is_symlink():sym.append(str(cur))
        rec["symlink_components"]=sym
    res.append(rec)
print(json.dumps({"mount_dev":md,"paths":res},indent=1))
